title: 削弱 — to weaken
summary: A short passage about to weaken.
summary_en: A short passage about to weaken.

paragraphs.text: 导演要求主题曲在旋律上保持克制，以免削弱影片结尾的留白效果。
paragraphs.hanzi: 导演要求主题曲在旋律上保持克制，以免削弱影片结尾的留白效果。
paragraphs.pinyin: dǎo yǎn yāo qiú zhǔ tí qū zài xuán lǜ shàng bǎo chí kè zhì ， yǐ miǎn xuē ruò yǐng piàn jié wěi de liú bái xiào guǒ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄉㄠˇ ㄧㄢˇ ㄧㄠ ㄑㄧㄡˊ ㄓㄨˇ ㄊㄧˊ ㄑㄩ ㄗㄞˋ ㄒㄩㄢˊ ㄌㄩˋ ㄕㄤˋ ㄅㄠˇ ㄔˊ ㄎㄜˋ ㄓˋ ， ㄧˇ ㄇㄧㄢˇ ㄒㄩㄝ ㄖㄨㄛˋ ㄧㄥˇ ㄆㄧㄢˋ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄨㄟˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄌㄧㄡˊ ㄅㄞˊ ㄒㄧㄠˋ ㄍㄨㄛˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Dǎoyǎn yāoqiú zhǔtíqǔ zài xuánlǜ shàng bǎochí kèzhì, yǐmiǎn xuēruò yǐngpiàn jiéwěi de liúbái xiàoguǒ.
paragraphs.translation: The director asked that the theme song remain restrained in melody, so as not to weaken the open-ended effect of the film’s ending.
paragraphs.translation_en: The director asked that the theme song remain restrained in melody, so as not to weaken the open-ended effect of the film’s ending.
paragraphs.translation_id: Sutradara meminta agar lagu tema tetap terkendali melodinya, agar tidak melemahkan efek open-ended di akhir film.

paragraphs.text: 一味迎合市场热点，反而会削弱品牌原有的辨识度。
paragraphs.hanzi: 一味迎合市场热点，反而会削弱品牌原有的辨识度。
paragraphs.pinyin: yī wèi yíng hé shì chǎng rè diǎn ， fǎn ér huì xuē ruò pǐn pái yuán yǒu de biàn shí dù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄧ ㄨㄟˋ ㄧㄥˊ ㄏㄜˊ ㄕˋ ㄔㄤˇ ㄖㄜˋ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ， ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄒㄩㄝ ㄖㄨㄛˋ ㄆㄧㄣˇ ㄆㄞˊ ㄩㄢˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄅㄧㄢˋ ㄕˊ ㄉㄨˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Yíwèi yínghé shìchǎng rèdiǎn, fǎn'ér huì xuēruò pǐnpái yuányǒu de biànshídù.
paragraphs.translation: Blindly catering to market trends may instead weaken a brand’s original recognisability.
paragraphs.translation_en: Blindly catering to market trends may instead weaken a brand’s original recognisability.
paragraphs.translation_id: Mengikuti tren pasar secara membabi buta justru dapat melemahkan pengenalan asli suatu merek.

paragraphs.text: 父母过分宠孩子，往往会削弱他面对挫折的能力。
paragraphs.hanzi: 父母过分宠孩子，往往会削弱他面对挫折的能力。
paragraphs.pinyin: fù mǔ guò fèn chǒng hái zi ， wǎng wǎng huì xuē ruò tā miàn duì cuò zhé de néng lì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄈㄨˋ ㄇㄨˇ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄔㄨㄥˇ ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ， ㄨㄤˇ ㄨㄤˇ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄒㄩㄝ ㄖㄨㄛˋ ㄊㄚ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄘㄨㄛˋ ㄓㄜˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄋㄥˊ ㄌㄧˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Fùmǔ guòfèn chǒng háizi, wǎngwǎng huì xuēruò tā miànduì cuòzhé de nénglì.
paragraphs.translation: Parents who pamper a child too much often weaken his ability to face setbacks.
paragraphs.translation_en: Parents who pamper a child too much often weaken his ability to face setbacks.
paragraphs.translation_id: Orang tua yang terlalu memanjakan anaknya sering kali melemahkan kemampuannya dalam menghadapi kegagalan.

paragraphs.text: 河道若长期不清淤，淤泥会逐渐削弱排水能力。
paragraphs.hanzi: 河道若长期不清淤，淤泥会逐渐削弱排水能力。
paragraphs.pinyin: hé dào ruò cháng qī bù qīng yū ， yū ní huì zhú jiàn xuē ruò pái shuǐ néng lì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄏㄜˊ ㄉㄠˋ ㄖㄨㄛˋ ㄔㄤˊ ㄑㄧ ㄅㄨˋ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄩ ， ㄩ ㄋㄧˊ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄨˊ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄒㄩㄝ ㄖㄨㄛˋ ㄆㄞˊ ㄕㄨㄟˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄌㄧˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Hédào ruò chángqī bù qīngyū, yūní huì zhújiàn xuēruò páishuǐ nénglì.
paragraphs.translation: If a river channel is not dredged for a long time, silt will gradually weaken its drainage capacity.
paragraphs.translation_en: If a river channel is not dredged for a long time, silt will gradually weaken its drainage capacity.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jika saluran sungai tidak dikeruk dalam waktu lama, lumpur lambat laun akan melemahkan kapasitas drainasenya.

paragraphs.text: 长期缺乏睡眠会削弱身体抵抗疾病的能力。
paragraphs.hanzi: 长期缺乏睡眠会削弱身体抵抗疾病的能力。
paragraphs.pinyin: cháng qī quē fá shuì mián huì xuē ruò shēn tǐ dǐ kàng jí bìng de néng lì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄔㄤˊ ㄑㄧ ㄑㄩㄝ ㄈㄚˊ ㄕㄨㄟˋ ㄇㄧㄢˊ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄒㄩㄝ ㄖㄨㄛˋ ㄕㄣ ㄊㄧˇ ㄉㄧˇ ㄎㄤˋ ㄐㄧˊ ㄅㄧㄥˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄋㄥˊ ㄌㄧˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Chángqī quēfá shuìmián huì xuēruò shēntǐ dǐkàng jíbìng de nénglì.
paragraphs.translation: Long-term lack of sleep weakens the body’s ability to resist disease.
paragraphs.translation_en: Long-term lack of sleep weakens the body’s ability to resist disease.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kurang tidur dalam jangka panjang melemahkan kemampuan tubuh untuk melawan penyakit.

paragraphs.text: 失业率长期在高位徘徊，削弱了消费者信心。
paragraphs.hanzi: 失业率长期在高位徘徊，削弱了消费者信心。
paragraphs.pinyin: shī yè lǜ cháng qī zài gāo wèi pái huái ， xuē ruò le xiāo fèi zhě xìn xīn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄕ ㄧㄝˋ ㄌㄩˋ ㄔㄤˊ ㄑㄧ ㄗㄞˋ ㄍㄠ ㄨㄟˋ ㄆㄞˊ ㄏㄨㄞˊ ， ㄒㄩㄝ ㄖㄨㄛˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄒㄧㄠ ㄈㄟˋ ㄓㄜˇ ㄒㄧㄣˋ ㄒㄧㄣ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Shīyè lǜ chángqī zài gāowèi páihuái, xuēruò le xiāofèi zhě xìnxīn.
paragraphs.translation: The unemployment rate has lingered at a high level for a long time, weakening consumer confidence.
paragraphs.translation_en: The unemployment rate has lingered at a high level for a long time, weakening consumer confidence.
paragraphs.translation_id: Tingkat pengangguran telah bertahan pada tingkat yang tinggi dalam waktu yang lama, sehingga melemahkan kepercayaan konsumen.

summary: A short passage about meaning; implication.
summary_en: A short passage about meaning; implication.

paragraphs.text: 婴儿分泌唾液增多，不一定意味着生病，也可能与出牙有关。
paragraphs.hanzi: 婴儿分泌唾液增多，不一定意味着生病，也可能与出牙有关。
paragraphs.pinyin: yīng ér fēn mì tuò yè zēng duō ， bù yí dìng yì wèi zhe shēng bìng ， yě kě néng yǔ chū yá yǒu guān 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄧㄥ ㄦˊ ㄈㄣ ㄇㄧˋ ㄊㄨㄛˋ ㄧㄝˋ ㄗㄥ ㄉㄨㄛ ， ㄅㄨˋ ㄧˊ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄧˋ ㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄜ˙ ㄕㄥ ㄅㄧㄥˋ ， ㄧㄝˇ ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄩˇ ㄔㄨ ㄧㄚˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄍㄨㄢ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Yīng'ér fēnmì tuòyè zēngduō, bù yídìng yìwèizhe shēngbìng, yě kěnéng yǔ chūyá yǒuguān.
paragraphs.translation: An increase in a baby’s saliva does not necessarily mean illness; it may also be related to teething.
paragraphs.translation_en: An increase in a baby’s saliva does not necessarily mean illness; it may also be related to teething.
paragraphs.translation_id: Peningkatan produksi air liur pada bayi tidak selalu berarti ia sedang sakit; hal itu mungkin juga berkaitan dengan proses tumbuh gigi.

paragraphs.text: 给别人起外号如果带有羞辱意味，就不再是亲密的幽默。
paragraphs.hanzi: 给别人起外号如果带有羞辱意味，就不再是亲密的幽默。
paragraphs.pinyin: gěi bié rén qǐ wài hào rú guǒ dài yǒu xiū rǔ yì wèi ， jiù bù zài shì qīn mì de yōu mò 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄍㄟˇ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄑㄧˇ ㄨㄞˋ ㄏㄠˋ ㄖㄨˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄉㄞˋ ㄧㄡˇ ㄒㄧㄡ ㄖㄨˇ ㄧˋ ㄨㄟˋ ， ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄕˋ ㄑㄧㄣ ㄇㄧˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄧㄡ ㄇㄛˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Gěi biérén qǐ wàihào rúguǒ dàiyǒu xiūrǔ yìwèi, jiù bù zài shì qīnmì de yōumò.
paragraphs.translation: If giving someone a nickname carries a humiliating meaning, it is no longer affectionate humour.
paragraphs.translation_en: If giving someone a nickname carries a humiliating meaning, it is no longer affectionate humour.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jika memberi julukan kepada seseorang mengandung makna yang merendahkan, hal itu tidak lagi bisa dianggap sebagai candaan yang penuh kasih sayang.

paragraphs.text: 公司上市只是一个里程碑，并不意味着创新可以停止。
paragraphs.hanzi: 公司上市只是一个里程碑，并不意味着创新可以停止。
paragraphs.pinyin: gōng sī shàng shì zhǐ shì yí gè lǐ chéng bēi ， bìng bù yì wèi zhe chuàng xīn kě yǐ tíng zhǐ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄍㄨㄥ ㄙ ㄕㄤˋ ㄕˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄧˊ ㄍㄜˋ ㄌㄧˇ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄟ ， ㄅㄧㄥˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄧˋ ㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄜ˙ ㄔㄨㄤˋ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄊㄧㄥˊ ㄓˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Gōngsī shàngshì zhǐshì yí gè lǐchéngbēi, bìng bù yìwèizhe chuàngxīn kěyǐ tíngzhǐ.
paragraphs.translation: The company going public is only a milestone; it does not mean innovation can stop.
paragraphs.translation_en: The company going public is only a milestone; it does not mean innovation can stop.
paragraphs.translation_id: Perusahaan yang go public hanyalah sebuah tonggak sejarah; bukan berarti inovasi bisa berhenti.

paragraphs.text: 这位译者以卓越的语感保留了原文的讽刺意味。
paragraphs.hanzi: 这位译者以卓越的语感保留了原文的讽刺意味。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè wèi yì zhě yǐ zhuó yuè de yǔ gǎn bǎo liú le yuán wén de fěng cì yì wèi 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄨㄟˋ ㄧˋ ㄓㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄓㄨㄛˊ ㄩㄝˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄩˇ ㄍㄢˇ ㄅㄠˇ ㄌㄧㄡˊ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄩㄢˊ ㄨㄣˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄈㄥˇ ㄘˋ ㄧˋ ㄨㄟˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhè wèi yìzhě yǐ zhuóyuè de yǔgǎn bǎoliú le yuánwén de fěngcì yìwèi.
paragraphs.translation: The translator preserved the irony of the original text with an outstanding feel for language.
paragraphs.translation_en: The translator preserved the irony of the original text with an outstanding feel for language.
paragraphs.translation_id: Penerjemah berhasil mempertahankan nuansa ironi teks aslinya berkat kepekaan bahasa yang luar biasa.

paragraphs.text: 对他而言，情人不仅意味着浪漫伴侣，也意味着能共同承担生活的人。
paragraphs.hanzi: 对他而言，情人不仅意味着浪漫伴侣，也意味着能共同承担生活的人。
paragraphs.pinyin: duì tā ér yán ， qíng rén bù jǐn yì wèi zhe làng màn bàn lǚ ， yě yì wèi zhe néng gòng tóng chéng dān shēng huó de rén 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄊㄚ ㄦˊ ㄧㄢˊ ， ㄑㄧㄥˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄐㄧㄣˇ ㄧˋ ㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄜ˙ ㄌㄤˋ ㄇㄢˋ ㄅㄢˋ ㄌㄩˇ ， ㄧㄝˇ ㄧˋ ㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄜ˙ ㄋㄥˊ ㄍㄨㄥˋ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄔㄥˊ ㄉㄢ ㄕㄥ ㄏㄨㄛˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄖㄣˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Duì tā ér yán, qíngrén bùjǐn yìwèizhe làngmàn bànlǚ, yě yìwèizhe néng gòngtóng chéngdān shēnghuó de rén.
paragraphs.translation: For him, a lover means not only a romantic partner, but someone who can share the burdens of life.
paragraphs.translation_en: For him, a lover means not only a romantic partner, but someone who can share the burdens of life.
paragraphs.translation_id: Baginya, kekasih bukan hanya berarti pasangan romantis, tapi seseorang yang bisa berbagi beban hidup.

paragraphs.text: 追赶并不意味着盲目模仿，落后者也可以通过差异化策略反超。
paragraphs.hanzi: 追赶并不意味着盲目模仿，落后者也可以通过差异化策略反超。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhuī gǎn bìng bù yì wèi zhe máng mù mó fǎng ， luò hòu zhě yě kě yǐ tōng guò chā yì huà cè lüè fǎn chāo 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄨㄟ ㄍㄢˇ ㄅㄧㄥˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄧˋ ㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄜ˙ ㄇㄤˊ ㄇㄨˋ ㄇㄛˊ ㄈㄤˇ ， ㄌㄨㄛˋ ㄏㄡˋ ㄓㄜˇ ㄧㄝˇ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄊㄨㄥ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄔㄚ ㄧˋ ㄏㄨㄚˋ ㄘㄜˋ ㄌㄩㄝˋ ㄈㄢˇ ㄔㄠ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhuīgǎn bìng bù yìwèizhe mángmù mófǎng, luòhòuzhě yě kěyǐ tōngguò chāyìhuà cèlüè fǎnchāo.
paragraphs.translation: Catching up does not mean blindly imitating; those who lag behind can also overtake through differentiated strategies.
paragraphs.translation_en: Catching up does not mean blindly imitating; those who lag behind can also overtake through differentiated strategies.
paragraphs.translation_id: Mengejar bukan berarti meniru secara membabi buta; mereka yang tertinggal juga dapat menyalip melalui strategi yang berbeda.

title: 董事 — director; board member
summary: A short passage about director; board member.
summary_en: A short passage about director; board member.
summary_id: Bacaan singkat tentang direktur; anggota dewan.

paragraphs.text: 外界以为董事长一毛不拔，其实他只是反对没有透明账目的捐款。
paragraphs.hanzi: 外界以为董事长一毛不拔，其实他只是反对没有透明账目的捐款。
paragraphs.pinyin: wài jiè yǐ wéi dǒng shì zhǎng yī máo bù bá ， qí shí tā zhǐ shì fǎn duì méi yǒu tòu míng zhàng mù dì juān kuǎn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄞˋ ㄐㄧㄝˋ ㄧˇ ㄨㄟˊ ㄉㄨㄥˇ ㄕˋ ㄓㄤˇ ㄧ ㄇㄠˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄅㄚˊ ， ㄑㄧˊ ㄕˊ ㄊㄚ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄈㄢˇ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄊㄡˋ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄓㄤˋ ㄇㄨˋ ㄉㄧˋ ㄐㄩㄢ ㄎㄨㄢˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Wàijiè yǐwéi dǒngshìzhǎng yìmáo-bùbá, qíshí tā zhǐ shì fǎnduì méiyǒu tòumíng zhàngmù de juānkuǎn.
paragraphs.translation: Outsiders thought the chairman was tight-fisted, but in fact he only opposed donations without transparent accounts.
paragraphs.translation_en: Outsiders thought the chairman was tight-fisted, but in fact he only opposed donations without transparent accounts.
paragraphs.translation_id: Orang luar menganggap ketua itu pelit, tetapi sebenarnya dia hanya menentang sumbangan yang tidak disertai laporan keuangan yang transparan.

paragraphs.text: 该公司任命了一名外籍董事，希望借此改善海外合规管理。
paragraphs.hanzi: 该公司任命了一名外籍董事，希望借此改善海外合规管理。
paragraphs.pinyin: gāi gōng sī rèn mìng le yī míng wài jí dǒng shì ， xī wàng jiè cǐ gǎi shàn hǎi wài hé guī guǎn lǐ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄍㄞ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄙ ㄖㄣˋ ㄇㄧㄥˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄧ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄨㄞˋ ㄐㄧˊ ㄉㄨㄥˇ ㄕˋ ， ㄒㄧ ㄨㄤˋ ㄐㄧㄝˋ ㄘˇ ㄍㄞˇ ㄕㄢˋ ㄏㄞˇ ㄨㄞˋ ㄏㄜˊ ㄍㄨㄟ ㄍㄨㄢˇ ㄌㄧˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Gāi gōngsī rènmìng le yì míng wàijí dǒngshì, xīwàng jiècǐ gǎishàn hǎiwài héguī guǎnlǐ.
paragraphs.translation: The company appointed a foreign director, hoping thereby to improve its overseas compliance management.
paragraphs.translation_en: The company appointed a foreign director, hoping thereby to improve its overseas compliance management.
paragraphs.translation_id: Perusahaan menunjuk seorang direktur asing, dengan harapan dapat meningkatkan manajemen kepatuhannya di luar negeri.

paragraphs.text: 这个方案看似周密，里面却藏着鬼主意，董事会很快识破了。
paragraphs.hanzi: 这个方案看似周密，里面却藏着鬼主意，董事会很快识破了。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè ge fāng àn kàn shì zhōu mì ， lǐ miàn què cáng zhe guǐ zhǔ yì ， dǒng shì huì hěn kuài shí pò le 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄍㄜ˙ ㄈㄤ ㄢˋ ㄎㄢˋ ㄕˋ ㄓㄡ ㄇㄧˋ ， ㄌㄧˇ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄑㄩㄝˋ ㄘㄤˊ ㄓㄜ˙ ㄍㄨㄟˇ ㄓㄨˇ ㄧˋ ， ㄉㄨㄥˇ ㄕˋ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄏㄣˇ ㄎㄨㄞˋ ㄕˊ ㄆㄛˋ ㄌㄜ˙ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhè gè fāng'àn kànsì zhōumì, lǐmiàn què cáng zhe guǐ zhǔyi, dǒngshìhuì hěn kuài shípò le.
paragraphs.translation: This plan looks thorough, but it hides a crafty trick, which the board soon saw through.
paragraphs.translation_en: This plan looks thorough, but it hides a crafty trick, which the board soon saw through.
paragraphs.translation_id: Rencana ini terlihat menyeluruh, namun menyembunyikan trik licik, yang segera diketahui oleh dewan.

paragraphs.text: 他多次试图插手人事安排，结果引起了董事会的警惕。
paragraphs.hanzi: 他多次试图插手人事安排，结果引起了董事会的警惕。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā duō cì shì tú chā shǒu rén shì ān pái ， jié guǒ yǐn qǐ le dǒng shì huì de jǐng tì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄘˋ ㄕˋ ㄊㄨˊ ㄔㄚ ㄕㄡˇ ㄖㄣˊ ㄕˋ ㄢ ㄆㄞˊ ， ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄧㄣˇ ㄑㄧˇ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄉㄨㄥˇ ㄕˋ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄐㄧㄥˇ ㄊㄧˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tā duō cì shìtú chāshǒu rénshì ānpái, jiéguǒ yǐnqǐ le dǒngshìhuì de jǐngtì.
paragraphs.translation: He repeatedly tried to interfere in personnel arrangements, which made the board wary.
paragraphs.translation_en: He repeatedly tried to interfere in personnel arrangements, which made the board wary.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia berulang kali mencoba ikut campur dalam pengaturan personalia, yang membuat dewan waspada.

paragraphs.text: 董事会陷入僵局后，独立董事提出了折中方案。
paragraphs.hanzi: 董事会陷入僵局后，独立董事提出了折中方案。
paragraphs.pinyin: dǒng shì huì xiàn rù jiāng jú hòu ， dú lì dǒng shì tí chū le zhé zhōng fāng àn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄉㄨㄥˇ ㄕˋ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄒㄧㄢˋ ㄖㄨˋ ㄐㄧㄤ ㄐㄩˊ ㄏㄡˋ ， ㄉㄨˊ ㄌㄧˋ ㄉㄨㄥˇ ㄕˋ ㄊㄧˊ ㄔㄨ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄓㄜˊ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄈㄤ ㄢˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Dǒngshìhuì xiànrù jiāngjú hòu, dúlì dǒngshì tíchū le zhézhōng fāng'àn.
paragraphs.translation: After the board reached a deadlock, the independent director proposed a compromise plan.
paragraphs.translation_en: After the board reached a deadlock, the independent director proposed a compromise plan.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setelah dewan menemui jalan buntu, direktur independen mengusulkan rencana kompromi.

paragraphs.text: 董事长没有安排正式宴会，只请几位老同事在家里吃顿便饭。
paragraphs.hanzi: 董事长没有安排正式宴会，只请几位老同事在家里吃顿便饭。
paragraphs.pinyin: dǒng shì zhǎng méi yǒu ān pái zhèng shì yàn huì ， zhǐ qǐng jǐ wèi lǎo tóng shì zài jiā lǐ chī dùn biàn fàn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄉㄨㄥˇ ㄕˋ ㄓㄤˇ ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄢ ㄆㄞˊ ㄓㄥˋ ㄕˋ ㄧㄢˋ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ， ㄓˇ ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄐㄧˇ ㄨㄟˋ ㄌㄠˇ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄕˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄌㄧˇ ㄔ ㄉㄨㄣˋ ㄅㄧㄢˋ ㄈㄢˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Dǒngshìzhǎng méiyǒu ānpái zhèngshì yànhuì, zhǐ qǐng jǐ wèi lǎo tóngshì zài jiālǐ chī dùn biànfàn.
paragraphs.translation: The chairman did not arrange a formal banquet, but simply invited a few old colleagues to his home for a simple meal.
paragraphs.translation_en: The chairman did not arrange a formal banquet, but simply invited a few old colleagues to his home for a simple meal.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ketua tidak mengatur jamuan makan formal, tetapi hanya mengundang beberapa rekan lama ke rumahnya untuk makan sederhana.
